palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Jump to a page, a server or a plugin
palette.placeholder: Jump to a page, server or plugin…

legend.title: What the statuses mean
legend.intro: The same colours mean the same thing everywhere: green is fine, amber needs attention, red is broken, grey is unknown.
legend.history: History: how did a sync end?
legend.actions: Plan actions: what a sync will do

Synced.label: Synced
Synced.description: Discord matches the active revision in git.

OutOfSync.label: Out of sync
OutOfSync.description: Discord differs from the active revision. The next sync applies the plan.

Unknown.label: Unknown
Unknown.description: Not compared yet: no bot connected or no sync so far.

Progressing.label: Progressing
Progressing.description: Starting or syncing; it should settle shortly.

Degraded.label: Degraded
Degraded.description: The last operation failed. The message explains why and how to fix it.

Missing.label: Missing
Missing.description: Not running: the bot is not connected or the server is not reachable.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Discord refused one or more changes. Nothing else was rolled back.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: The revision is invalid; the runtime kept the last valid one.

create.label: Create
create.description: Declared in YAML, missing on Discord: it will be created.

update.label: Update
update.description: Exists on Discord with different values: they will be changed.

delete.label: Delete
delete.description: Removed from YAML and pruning is on: it will be deleted on Discord.

adopt.label: Adopt
adopt.description: An existing resource with the same name becomes managed by CODI.

reorder.label: Reorder
reorder.description: Positions will be changed to follow the YAML order.

unmanage.label: Unmanage
unmanage.description: Removed from YAML: CODI stops managing it but leaves it on Discord.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: A safety rule prevents this change; it is not applied.

errors.otherFailures_one: {{count}} other change failed in the same sync.
errors.otherFailures_other: {{count}} other changes failed in the same sync.

network.title: Can't reach the runtime
network.message: The CODI runtime did not answer.
network.hint: Check that codi is running and reachable, then retry.

forbidden.title: Not available with your role
forbidden.message: Your role on this server does not allow this.
forbidden.hint: Ask a server admin for access (spec.access in the server YAML).

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.message: It may have been removed from the repository.

conflict.title: Changed since you opened it
conflict.message: Someone changed the configuration in the meantime.
conflict.hint: Reload to get the latest version, then redo your change.

invalid.title: Some values are invalid
invalid.hint: Fix the highlighted fields and try again.

unavailable.title: The runtime is not ready
unavailable.message: The runtime cannot do this right now.
unavailable.hint: Check the bot status, then retry in a moment.

internal.title: The runtime hit an internal error
internal.message: This is a bug in CODI, not in your configuration.
internal.hint: Retry; if it persists, check the runtime logs.

login.title: Sign in to the operator console
login.text: Manage the servers, bots and plugins this runtime reconciles from git. Access comes from the spec.access section of each server.
login.devOnly: Dev login only works with codi dev.

dev.title: Dev login
dev.text: Pick a simulated user. The server owner is admin everywhere.
dev.byId: Available with codi dev only: sign in as any Discord user ID.

noAccess.title: No server to manage
noAccess.text: You are signed in as {{name}}, but you are not an admin or moderator of any server this runtime manages. Ask an owner to add you to spec.access in the server's YAML.

rejected.title: The latest revision was rejected
rejected.hint: The runtime keeps running the last valid revision until a fix is pushed.

noBots.title: No bot on this server
noBots.text: List this server in a bot's spec.servers.

confirm.title: Apply the plan to Discord?
confirm.text: CODI changes Discord to match the active revision. Blocked operations are skipped. Review the plan first if you are unsure.

toast.blocked_one: {{count}} change blocked by the sync policy
toast.blocked_other: {{count}} changes blocked by the sync policy

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: What the next sync would change on Discord to match the active revision.

adminOnly.title: The plan is for admins
adminOnly.text: Only server admins can preview and apply the reconciliation plan. Drift is visible to moderators too.

empty.title: Nothing to change
empty.text: Discord already matches the active revision.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.text: Safety rules prevent these operations. They are not applied.

blockedReason.deletionProtection: Removed from the YAML, but deletion protection is on (syncPolicy.deletionProtection).
blockedReason.hierarchy: The bot's role is not above this role in the hierarchy.
blockedReason.ownership: Another owner (a plugin) manages this resource.
blockedReason.typechange: Discord cannot change a channel's type in place.

history.title: History
history.description: Syncs, revision activations and bot reloads, newest first. Identical consecutive results are grouped.

empty.title: Nothing synced yet
empty.text: Entries appear after the first sync or revision.

drift.title: Drift
drift.description: Fields changed on Discord that differ from the active revision in git.

empty.title: No drift
empty.text: Discord matches the YAML of the active revision.

resources.title: Roles & channels
resources.description: What exists on Discord. Managed resources are declared in {{file}} and have a key.
resources.managedHint: Key in the YAML: CODI manages this resource
resources.unmanagedHint: Exists only on Discord. CODI leaves it alone.

serverSettings.title: Server settings
serverSettings.description: The server profile, sync policy and access declared in git.

readOnly.title: Edited in git
readOnly.text: These values come from {{file}}. Change them in the repository; the runtime applies them on the next revision.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Managed only when set in the YAML.
profile.name: Name

policy.title: Sync policy
policy.description: How CODI reconciles Discord with git.
policy.selfHealHelp: Revert changes made on Discord as soon as they are seen.
policy.pruneHelp: Delete resources removed from the YAML (otherwise they are only unmanaged).
policy.deletionProtectionHelp: Block every deletion, even with prune on.

access.title: Access
access.description: Who can use this console for the server. The server owner is always admin.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Configuration changes, syncs and logins on this server. Stored in the runtime database, not in git.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Plugin instances running on this server. Saving settings commits to git; the runtime then activates the new revision.

empty.title: No plugins on this server
empty.text: Add a plugin to a bot's spec.plugins and list this server in spec.servers.

outcome.prText: The change applies once it is merged.

editor.saveFirst: Save or discard your changes first
editor.onlyDiff: only what differs from the base
editor.everyServer: applies to every server of bot {{bot}}
editor.baseEffective: The form shows the effective values on {{server}}. Saving to the base writes them all as the shared base config.
editor.baseOverride: Editing the base config. On {{server}} the override still wins for {{fields}}.
editor.overridesTail: ; other fields come from the base config.

readOnly.title: Read only
readOnly.text: Your role on this server cannot change these settings. Fields marked x-codi-access: moderator are editable by moderators.

editor.someLocked: Some fields are for admins only; you can view them.

conflict.title: The configuration changed since you opened it

forbidden.title: Your role cannot save this change
forbidden.hint: Moderators can only change fields marked x-codi-access: moderator; ask an admin for the others.

editor.denied: Your role may not change {{fields}}; the runtime will refuse this save.
editor.commitNote: Committed to git, then applied by the runtime

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Preferences of this console, stored in this browser.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Follow the system, or pick a theme.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your Discord identity and your role on each server.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: The CODI runtime this console talks to.

form.lockedHint: You can view this field but not change it

errors.duration: Use a duration such as 30s, 10m or 1h30m
errors.color: Use a hex color such as #5865f2

sim.startText: Send a message, or join a user to see the welcome plugin post here.

off.title: The simulator is off
off.text: Start the runtime with codi dev --sim to play with your bots without Discord.

noServer.title: No simulated server
noServer.text: The simulated world has no server yet.

live.polling: Live updates unavailable: polling every 2.5 s

dms.title: Direct messages
dms.hint: What bots sent to each user
dms.noneText: The welcome plugin DMs an onboarding link when a member joins.

toast.createdText: Join them to the server to trigger the welcome flow.

result.label: Interaction result
result.deferred: The bot acknowledged the interaction; its answer will arrive as an edit or followup.

composer.notMember: {{user}} is not a member: join the server first.
composer.joinToRun: Join the server with this user to run commands.

members.title: Members
members.allIn: Everyone is in. Create a user below.

quick.label: Quick start
quick.title: See your bot work in 30 seconds

join.title: Join a user
join.text: The welcome plugin greets them in the welcome channel and gives them a role.
join.done: Everyone has joined: create a user on the right.

dms.title: Open their DMs
dms.text: The bot sends a link to the onboarding page of the portal.

commands.none: No slash commands on this server
commands.noneText: Plugins register commands with command() in definePlugin.
